Close-up of rear serial/model sticker for edition verification.

response.reason: The item is identifiable by type as a PS4 Slim console from the visible logo and body shape, but with no proof of power-on function, no visible accessories, and no verification of the special edition claim, it must be priced at worst case as a console-only unit of unverified working condition.
